buildText: Great. Use the button below to open the Get Started form. Anything you told me here is already filled in.

cold-calling.text: Which state or markets are you targeting?
Are you thinking about one caller, two to four, or five or more?

Our dedicated caller service starts at $1,299 per month for one caller, with calling infrastructure and management included. Send your details and our team will scope the calling plan for your market. Your answers are already filled in.

production-team.text: What U.S. markets do you work in?

A Production Team is scoped around your existing people and processes; there is no flat package price. Send your details and our team will put together a plan for your business. Your answers are already filled in.

support.text: Are you an agent team, brokerage, investor or acquisition company, or wholesaler?
Which state or markets are you targeting?
Your support mix is scoped to your operation rather than a fixed package. Send your details and our team will suggest a starting point. Your answers are already filled in.

rules.text: Pricing starts at $1,299 per month for one dedicated caller. Larger teams and a managed Production Team are quoted around the roles and support you need. Would you like help choosing a starting point?
Omnikom works with your existing CRM and agreed handoffs. Your business keeps ownership of its records and client relationships.
Omnikom provides managed execution and activity reporting, not guaranteed leads, appointments, or deals. Results depend on your market, prospect quality, follow-up, and other factors.
We provide dedicated, managed real estate callers for property-owner prospecting. Are you an agent team, brokerage, investor, or wholesaler?
We can connect prospecting, ISA follow-up, marketing execution, and transaction administration. How many agents or acquisition professionals are on your team, roughly?
We support lead qualification and follow-up, marketing execution, and administrative transaction coordination. Are you looking for one function or several together?
